event_time: discrete discovery events; no timestamps or exponential clocks

active_member.punishment: choose non-target sibling when target flagged

gamma.meaning: fraction or reduced-form probability of neutral non-target hash owning neither sibling that mines on the target branch
gamma.ownership_precedence: target and competing sibling owners remain on their own branches
gamma.active_flagged_override: neutral active punisher chooses non-target sibling

lambda.meaning: Bernoulli probability of a one-discovery pending propagation window
lambda.eligible: honest-strategy public blocks and selfish-strategy non-target public blocks at lead zero

classification.scope: target identity for full conditional simulation
